contracts.title: Offline during selected weight transfer
prerequisite_fixes: Credit deployed #1663 fault-status teardown correction; no new recovery product fix assigned.
A5 complete adverse transition history and A6 selected request/attempt/fault binding qualified; A1/A2 applies.
Named selected weight request must actually be exercised; generic model config failure is insufficient.
exact_stimulus: Cold model attempt; arm request/counter/history before Start and observe selected weight genuinely in flight. Arm fault phase/counter before await setOffline(true); retain induction success and failures during await.
Observe failure/Retry without acting until status/handler settles; remove only approved injected cause, perform explicit Retry, then authorized recovered take Stop/save.
expected_observable_sequence: Initial loading→actual selected transfer→injected fault→settled handler with truthful visible error/Retry.
No published ready in fault interval, including same-callback ready→error; no automatic Cloud fallback/recording.
Explicit new Retry attempt after cause removed→ready→recovered saved take; attempt-bound history keeps recovery ready separate from prior false ready.
case_binding: Selected model asset/weight hash/path privately retained, request ID + loader + attempt, injection armed/start/settled time, failure callback and settled handler, observed status document/window, Retry new attempt and recovered saved take/release.
pass_conditions: Intended fault exercised, truthful persistent error/Retry, complete no-false-ready history, explicit bound recovery/save/no-Cloud and finalization proof.
hold_conditions: No selected request in flight, failed/unknown induction, generic /models/ count only, lost/incomplete observer, wrong attempt or missing settled handler.
Known ready during unresolved fault or false idle/hidden error remains FAIL, not HOLD.
cleanup_evidence: Restore only run-local injected route/offline setting before recovery/finalization; close context; account cleanup exactly once plus residue proof. Do not alter provider/configuration or shared Production.

implementation_decision.input: Select exact weight/attempt match and settled-handler evidence schema; sequence already acknowledged, published implementation/qualified release still missing.
